articles.summary: Mayor Beth Bauman started the South St. Paul Mayor’s Youth Task Force with a specific mission: reduce underage drinking and smoking. Just seven years later, that mission has been accomplished. Read about the group’s success here. Now for 2015, the task force has a new goal.
articles.title: Mission Completely Possible: South St. Paul Task Force Takes On Crossing Safety
